name: Grid Data Bars
tagline: In-cell proportional bars for bounded numeric columns on the Power Apps grid.
summary:
A grid customizer that draws a bar behind each value of a numeric column on the Power Apps grid, so outliers and clusters are visible before any number is read.

- The bar is scaled to the minimum and maximum the column declares in Dataverse, never to the values on the page
- The platform's own formatted number stays on top, unchanged
- A column that declares no range keeps the grid's ordinary cell

Model-driven apps only. It is assigned to a table's grid rather than placed on a form.

limitations: The ranges come from the demo’s stand-in Dataverse, read through EntityDefinitions(…)/Attributes the way a model-driven grid answers them. Credit limit, Satisfaction and Win probability declare a Minimum and Maximum, so they draw bars; Annual revenue and Employees are left at the platform’s default range and draw none, which is what most numeric columns on most tables look like.

Values print as the stored number — 420000 rather than $420,000.00 — because the demo’s grid hands a renderer the stored value as its formatted value too. A real grid formats currency and decimals by the user’s settings; the bars are unaffected.
The grid is PCFHub’s stand-in, not the Power Apps grid: the cell renderers run for real, the surrounding grid does not, and sorting, filtering and paging are not modelled.

presets.name: Accounts with ranges
presets.description: Three columns with a declared range draw bars; two left at the platform's default range decline and keep the grid's own cells.
